1416 duno {doo'-no} or dumi {doo'-mee} or duo {doo'-o}

prolonged forms of an obsolete primary duo {doo'-o} (to sink);
   TDNT - 2:318,192; v

AV - set 2; 2

1) to go into, enter
2) go under, be plunged into, sink in
